evidence.source: Academia Sinica, Institute of History and Philology, Chinese Character Database
evidence.text: The entry for 亻 defines it as 「人」的偏旁異寫: an alternative side-component form of 人. This supports treating 人 → 亻 as a positional/full-form relationship, not as a historical-ancestor claim.
evidence.title: 漢字「亻」：基本資料

evidence.field: Summary; Source; Permission; Licensing; Original file
evidence.text: The page identifies 人-seal.svg as a digital rendering of 人 in Shuowen seal-script style, lists Sinica among its sources, and states CC0 1.0 terms. It links the original SVG at https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/d/d3/%E4%BA%BA-seal.svg. It is a modern vector rendering, not a photograph of an ancient artifact or a form of 们.

gaps: The 亻 entry supports its positional relationship to 人, but does not establish a separate historical sequence for 亻 within 們.
The 人 seal-script image illustrates 人 alone, not an early form of 們; it cannot document 們’s graphic development.

items.period: Seal-script style; modern digital rendering, not an artifact photograph
items.caption: A modern vector rendering of 人 in Shuowen seal-script style. It illustrates the full form associated with the positional component 亻; it is not an early form of 們.
items.selection_reason: The Academia Sinica character entry directly supports the 人-to-亻 positional relationship, and this rights-cleared image supplies a visual example of 人. Its scope is limited to the component relationship; it does not show 們’s historical development.
items.rights: CC0 1.0; the Commons page states public-domain dedication.

limitations.text: No character-specific early form or graphic sequence for 們 was established. The selected image depicts 人 alone and is a modern vector rendering, not an ancient artifact image.
